facts: From the native context, app_type and app_fill into a node of a WebView's page go in through the page when it can be reached and one page element clearly matches the node's rectangle.
The page is then asked whether a person could type there, so a read-only field is refused with 'readonly attribute' and keeps its text.
With no reachable page (an app that has not opened its WebView to debugging) or no clear match, the text goes in natively as before, and a read-only field can still take it.
note: 301 alone, checked against the code (handlers.go:2118 inWebView -> webview.go typeThroughPage, then webFill). Stored answer describes the defect, not the fix: it read the 'Found by' half of 301. Not a doc problem.
